<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a body part that can be extracted from a corpse at the [[preparation place|autopsy table]]. Upon removal, it has the effect of adding one Red Skull {{Skull|red}} and removing one White Skull {{Skull|white}}. In addition, similar to most other anatomy and theology items, it can be studied at the [[Study table]] for a {{Techpoint|Blue}} reward. For more information, see [[corpses]].
